bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%

title: Boots of Kurak
name: Boots of Kurak
desc: The boots of an insane magi.
intro: This sorcerer garb was once worn by the mad sorcerer Kurak, a powerful and feared figure in the Exiled Lands. Kurak was known for his twisted and dark experiments, insatiable thirst for power, and timely demise before his sinister schemes could bear fruit.

title: Boots of Sobek
name: Boots of Sobek
desc: Boots made of thick reptile leather
intro: Only the chosen of Sobek are allowed to wear this armor. The scales themselves are thicker than regular crocodile scales, and it has been further reinforced by star metal plates. As a result, the armor is much heavier than normal medium armor but offers additional protection.

intro: A strange set of armor, crafted by a cult of maniacs. A forbidden sect of passionate fools that insanely believed they could become that which they worshipped, a demon of the abyss - if only they dressed as one first (and sacrificed as many souls as possible).

intro: The pirates of the Black Hand are the most dangerous kind of pirates - shipless, aimless and destitute. They search desperately for a way to leave the Exiled Lands and they form strange alliances and quirky plans to help them achieve that goal. So far, nothing has come to fruition.

title: Gloves of Jhil
name: Gloves of Jhil
desc: Gloves forged by the Children of Jhil
intro: Forged of the same metal as the vaults, these gloves are finely crafted and speak of a technological sophistication that was lost to humankind with the drowning of the world in the great cataclysm. That the Elder Races can still create such pieces, even in their degenerate state, speaks volumes to the power of oral history and racial memory.

title: Gloves of the Watchers

desc: Gloves worn by the Cult of Watchers
intro: They call them the Watchers. They cannot be seen, but their abysmal and blasphemous forms are myriad. They lurk in the outer darkness of formless voids and nighted gulfs, and they watch.

The magical energies that surge through these boots grant additional Encumbrance and repairs the equipped weapon for a slight amount when the wearer takes damage.

title: Gurnakhi Boots (Battle Pass Epic)
name: Gurnakhi Boots
desc: A pair of sturdy boots
dlc: Battle Pass: Age of Sorcery - Chapter 1
intro: The fearsome marauders known as the Gurnakhi are little known beyond the icy climes of their frigid realm. Perhaps the Vanir or rival Aesir might whisper of inhuman slavers from the northern wastes, but beyond the campfires of Nordheim, knowledge of their kind is non-existent. How they or their trappings came to be in the Exiled Lands is a mystery that may never be solved.

title: Hands of the Goblinoid
name: Hands of the Goblinoid
desc: Gloves forged by the Elder Goblin Races
intro: Forged of the same metal as the vaults, these gloves are finely crafted and speak of a technological sophistication that was lost to humankind with the drowning of the world in the great cataclysm. That the Elder Races can still create such pieces, even in their degenerate state, speaks volumes to the power of oral history and racial memory.

title: Harness of the Mad Prophet
name: Harness of the Mad Prophet
desc: A protective harness of ancient design
intro: This armor set bears the symbols and iconography of a lost age. Neither its colors nor styling corresponds to any known kingdom or military formation of the Hyborian Age. In hot, arid climates, the harness offers a modicum of chest and shoulder protection without the enclosing the wearer -- like an extremely small poncho.

title: Harness of the Mad Prophet (Epic)
name: Harness of the Mad Prophet
desc: A protective harness of ancient design
intro: This armor set bears the symbols and iconography of a lost age. Neither its colors nor styling corresponds to any known kingdom or military formation of the Hyborian Age. title: Headband of Zath
name: Headband of Zath
desc: A headband worn by dancers of Zath
intro: The temple dancers of Yezud are famous for their cavorting in front of the idol of their spider god. Naked but for strings of beads in webbed patterns, the dancers are all virgins, set to serve in the temple for five years.

title: Headdress of Jhebbal Sag
name: Headdress of Jhebbal Sag
desc: A formal headdress worn by Jhebbal Sag priests
intro: The worship of Jhebbal Sag has long been forgotten by the civilized Hyborians, but his priests in the Black Kingdoms and Pictish wilderness still spread his religion through fear and violence.

title: Heavy Gauntlets
name: Heavy Gauntlets
desc: Steel-plated gauntlets
intro: These gauntlets are adorned with overlapping plates of steel, which keeps the main hand protected while allowing full flexibility and mobility in the off-hand.

title: Heavy Gauntlets (Epic)
name: Heavy Gauntlets
desc: Elbow length gauntlets of riveted leather
intro: Protecting the forearms and fingers is the primary purpose of gauntlets. The loss of a hand will cripple a warrior and the loss of fingers will cripple an archer.

title: Heavy Helmet
name: Heavy Helmet
desc: A horned steel helmet
intro: This helmet, ornamented with a pair of horns, is designed to ward off powerful blows to the head and keep the wearer's brains on the inside of their skull.

title: Heavy Helmet (Epic)
name: Heavy Helmet
desc: A riveted leather cap with a facemask
intro: This leather helmet includes large cheek and neck protectors and a facemask for filtering the sand and dust from the air.

title: Heavy Leather Helmet
name: Heavy Leather Helmet
desc: A heavy leather helmet
intro: This helmet is designed to ward off powerful blows to the head and keep the wearer's brains on the inside of their skull.

title: Heavy Pauldron
name: Heavy Pauldron
desc: A heavy vest that offers significant protection
intro: Designed with defence in mind, this heavy pauldron is reinforced with overlapping steel plates on the main hand. This offers optimal protection and stability mid-swing, while allowing the wearer room to breathe and remain cool.

title: Heavy Pauldron (Epic)
name: Heavy Pauldron
desc: Leather spaulders riveted to articulated rerebraces
intro: The fastest way to a man's heart, is through his armpits' is a common expression amongst the gladiators of Argos. Chest protection is often reinforced on the upper arms and the vulnerable areas around the armpits, rather than the central chest. Every human is already born with some natural protection over their hearts namely their ribcage and breastbone.

title: Heavy Plated Helmet
name: Heavy Plated Helmet
desc: A steel helmet
intro: This helmet is designed to ward off powerful blows to the head and keep the wearer's brains on the inside of their skull.

title: Heavy Sabatons
name: Heavy Sabatons
desc: Steel-plated heavy-toed boots
intro: The upper sides of these boots are covered with a layer of steel to protect against any attacks made at that vulnerable area. The feet are often overlooked as an element of protection, but as King Namedides of Aquilonia once remarked "The enemy can't run without legs!".

title: Heavy Sabatons (Epic)
name: Heavy Sabatons
desc: Calf-length riveted leather boots
intro: These boots offer good protection for the calves and feet and their sturdy construction means that they tolerate the harsh conditions for a long time.

title: Heavy Tasset
name: Heavy Tasset
desc: A steel-plated skirt for protecting the upper thighs
intro: Sewn together with riveted leather and adjoined steel plates, this skirt allows free movement of the legs while in battle, while protecting the waist and upper thighs from damage.

title: Heavy Tasset (Epic)
name: Heavy Tasset
desc: A leather skirt that protects the upper thighs
intro: This long leather skirt is designed to protect the upper thighs from attacks while providing mobility.

title: Helm of Kraxus
name: Helm of Kraxus
desc: Helm of Kraxus the Bastard
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +6%, Follower Damage +8%, Concussive Damage +10%
intro: Kraxus, also known as 'the Bastard', was called so because his men hated him with a passion. He tended to stay safely behind the lines while his men did the fighting, and when the battles were over, he claimed all the credit and reaped all the rewards.

title: Helm of Sobek
name: Helm of Sobek
desc: A helmet made of thick reptile leather
intro: Only the chosen of Sobek are allowed to wear this armor. The scales themselves are thicker than regular crocodile scales, and it has been further reinforced by star metal plates. As a result, the armor is much heavier than normal medium armor but offers additional protection.

title: Helm of the Brute
name: Helm of the Brute
desc: A helmet made of thick reptile leather
intro: This helm grants the wearer a bonus to their strength.

title: Helm of the Fiend (Battle Pass Epic)
name: Helm of the Fiend
desc: A helmet shaped like a demon's head
dlc: Battle Pass: Age of Sorcery - Chapter 1
intro: A cult of maniacs crafted this strange set of armor. A forbidden sect of deranged souls that insanely believed they could become that which they worshipped, a demon of the abyss - if only they dressed as one first (and sacrificed as many souls as possible).

desc: A headpiece worn by the Followers of Asura
intro: Prophets, Centors, Legates and Protectors of the faith of Asura, the Followers of Asura are known for their worldly knowledge as well as their helpfulness.

title: Hood of Kurak
name: Hood of Kurak
desc: The hood of an insane magi.
intro: This sorcerer garb and mask were once worn by the mad sorcerer Kurak, a powerful and feared figure in the Exiled Lands. Kurak was known for his twisted and dark experiments, insatiable thirst for power, and timely demise.

name: Hook (Left Fitting)
desc: A replacement prosthetic for a hand

title: Perfected Heavy Gauntlets
name: Perfected Heavy Gauntlets
desc: Elbow length gauntlets of riveted leather
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: Protecting the forearms and fingers is the primary purpose of gauntlets. The loss of a hand will cripple a warrior and the loss of fingers will cripple an archer.

title: Perfected Heavy Helmet
name: Perfected Heavy Helmet
desc: A riveted leather cap with a facemask
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: This leather helmet includes large cheek and neck protectors and a facemask for filtering the sand and dust from the air.

title: Perfected Heavy Pauldron
name: Perfected Heavy Pauldron
desc: Leather spaulders riveted to articulated rerebraces
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: The fastest way to a man's heart, is through his armpits' is a common expression amongst the gladiators of Argos. Chest protection is often reinforced on the upper arms and the vulnerable areas around the armpits, rather than the central chest. Every human is already born with some natural protection over their hearts namely their ribcage and breastbone.

title: Perfected Heavy Sabatons
name: Perfected Heavy Sabatons
desc: Calf-length riveted leather boots
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: These boots offer good protection for the calves and feet and their sturdy construction means that they tolerate the harsh conditions for a long time.

title: Perfected Heavy Tasset
name: Perfected Heavy Tasset
desc: A leather skirt that protects the upper thighs
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: This long leather skirt is designed to protect the upper thighs from attacks while providing mobility.

title: Perfected Light Boots
name: Perfected Light Boots
desc: A pair of sturdy boots made from cloth and hide
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%

title: Perfected Light Chestpiece
name: Perfected Light Chestpiece
desc: A light chestpiece of hide and fiber
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: Designed to keep the wearer cool, this armor emphasizes movement and agility in combat over straight up protection.

title: Perfected Light Gauntlets
name: Perfected Light Gauntlets
desc: A pair of flexible hide gauntlets
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%

title: Perfected Light Turban

desc: A simple turban of hide and fiber
bonus: Strength Weapon Damage +3%, Agility Weapon Damage +3%
intro: In the Exiled Lands, the fierce sun beating down on the unprotected head can cause extreme delirium in a short amount of time.

title: Perfected Light Wrap

desc: A breechclout worn by Pictish braves
intro: Pictland is a vast swathe of wilderness that covers every type of terrain from forest and woodlands to murky swamps and temperate coastline. And for every type of terrain, there is a Pictish clan thriving. There are hundreds of tribes and clans - Alligator, Hawk, Eagle, Wildcat, Wolf, Raven, and Turtles. Consequently, every tribe has their own traditions for battle and dress.
